propositions: Code review must compile DiscoveryStagePlan units from immutable CriteriaSnapshot and execute through shared discovery kernel instead of combining workflow-authored criteria with unconditional Round-A fan-in and packaged-only overlay selection.

Effective disables, project DET criteria, file applicability, and explicit dollar budgets must be respected; criteria should execute zero times with stored reason provenance when disabled or non-applicable.
After one local criterion call exhausts, retain successes and continue independent criteria; missing blocking-capable coverage returns unsigned INDETERMINATE unless a real block exists.
Authored code-review.yaml topology, base-reviewer payload, per-overlay context, prompt contracts, model-ladder resolution, sequential scheduling, and absence of checkpoints must be preserved.
Positive authored usd_budget values must be enforced with shed units recorded; zero budget remains schema-invalid and uncapped omission is allowed.
Versioned safe discovery trace must persist internally in code-review journal without adding trace fields to response; shadow contract tests verify no differences outside approved delta allowlist.
